name: Data Exfiltration Response Playbook
description: Containment and data breach response for SCADA configuration and process data exfiltration

actions.description: Block the destination IP receiving the exfiltrated data at perimeter firewall
Quarantine all suspicious outbound connections for forensic inspection
Revoke all tokens for compromised service account to halt ongoing exfiltration
Archive complete network flow logs for the breach window to establish data scope
Notify CISO and legal team — potential regulatory notification requirement (GDPR/NERC CIP)
Open data breach incident in SOC with full scope assessment and regulatory timeline

recovery_steps: Determine exact scope of exfiltrated data (type, volume, sensitivity)
Assess regulatory notification requirements (72hr clock for GDPR if applicable)
Rotate all credentials and secrets potentially exposed in exfiltrated configs
Patch the access vector used for exfiltration
Implement data loss prevention (DLP) controls to prevent recurrence
Commission external forensics if scope is unclear
